data: © NASA / Viking Project — orbiter operated through 1980, 50,000+ images returned.

Returned over 50,000 images of Mars's surface and moons over four years. Mapped potential landing sites in advance for both Viking landers. Ended operations in August 1980 when its attitude-control gas was depleted.
First long-duration Mars orbital reconnaissance — produced the first Mars atlas.
First fully successful Mars landing; first long-duration surface science
First successful Mars lander; biology experiments
